comentarios: Presumably nominate gujanensis; see comments under XC357410. At least one pair calling from dense successional scrub, c. 1 m tall, bordering an overgrown chacra, abutting várzea forest. Also in the background from c. 0:31 seconds is the Thamnophilus palliatus-type bird discussed in Florez, P. (2017) A mysterious antshrike in eastern Colombia. Neotrop. Birding 20: 21–24.
